claims.statement: Niki Lauda won the Formula One Drivers’ World Championship in 1975, 1977 and 1984.

evidence.locator: PDF page 80 / printed page 77, Drivers’ World Championship Winners table; corresponding driver and championship years

claims.statement: The official 1975 drivers' championship classification lists Niki Lauda first for Ferrari on 64.5 points, ahead of Emerson Fittipaldi on 45.

evidence.locator: 1975 Drivers' Standings, positions 1 and 2, driver/team/points columns (classification points, not raw per-race sum)

claims.statement: Niki Lauda returned at the 1976 Italian Grand Prix, six weeks after his German Grand Prix accident, and finished fourth.

evidence.locator: Hall of Fame paragraph starting 'Six weeks later', documenting the Italian Grand Prix return and fourth place.

claims.statement: Lauda returned to Formula 1 with McLaren in 1982 after leaving the championship in 1979.

evidence.locator: Hall of Fame passages describing his 1979 retirement in Canada and 1982 McLaren signing.
